2026_04_JAX_CIN.headline: Jacksonville’s takeaway-minded defense faces Cincinnati’s resurgent passing attack on the road
2026_04_JAX_CIN.paragraph1: Trevor Lawrence brings Jacksonville into Cincinnati after a three-touchdown Week 3 performance, while Joe Burrow returns home with a Bengals offense that still depends on clean protection and timing. Liam Coen’s Jaguars can stress Cincinnati with pressure and takeaway opportunities, but Zac Taylor’s offense has enough receiving talent to punish overaggressive rush lanes. Jacksonville must make Burrow hold the ball without surrendering explosive throws; Cincinnati must keep Lawrence from controlling the game with efficient early-down passing.
2026_04_JAX_CIN.model_rationale: Jacksonville’s disruptive defense can swing possessions, but Cincinnati’s protection and passing efficiency are positioned to test whether those takeaways travel against a stronger offense.
